assertions.query: SELECT KhieuNaiID id,COUNT(*) n FROM dbo.XULY_KHIEUNAI WHERE NoiDungXuLy=N'R82 admin target A' GROUP BY KhieuNaiID;

SELECT k.KhieuNaiID id,k.TrangThai status,COUNT(x.XuLyID) processingCount FROM dbo.KHIEUNAI k JOIN dbo.XULY_KHIEUNAI x ON x.KhieuNaiID=k.KhieuNaiID WHERE k.KhieuNaiID=@ID GROUP BY k.KhieuNaiID,k.TrangThai;

SELECT d.DonDatVeID id,d.SuatChieuID showtimeId,d.TongTienVe ticketTotal,d.TongTienDoAn foodTotal,d.TienGiamGia discount,COUNT(v.VeID) seats,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CHITIETDOAN f WHERE f.DonDatVeID=d.DonDatVeID) foodLines FROM dbo.DONDATVE d JOIN dbo.CHITIETVE v ON v.DonDatVeID=d.DonDatVeID GROUP BY d.DonDatVeID,d.SuatChieuID,d.TongTienVe,d.TongTienDoAn,d.TienGiamGia;
SELECT SuatChieuID id,COUNT(*) n FROM dbo.DONDATVE GROUP BY SuatChieuID;
